title: "Unison: a new distributed programming language" by Paul Chiusano
summary: Paul Chiusano's Strange Loop 2019 talk introduces Unison, an open-source functional language for distributed, elastic systems. It covers content-addressed code identified by hashes of the syntax tree, a codebase manager, and algebraic effects called abilities.
why: HN treats it as the best introduction to Unison, with commenters finding hash-addressed immutable code mind-blowing.

quote.text: this talk might be a better introduction than just skimming at the landing page.
